limitations: VIIRS 375 m detects far smaller and cooler fires than MODIS 1 km; a shared grid cell does not equalize detection capability.
Comparable cell-days require detections from both families on the same day in the same cell; overpass timing and cloud cover make this a lower bound on true co-observation.
MODIS Terra (morning) and Aqua (early afternoon) see different fires; VIIRS afternoon overpasses overlap Aqua timing more closely than Terra.
Zero detections in a shared cell-day is not zero fire.
